cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Muta: an offline tutor that teaches African students at every level to reason through maths and science problems

test_prompts.prompt: Multiple choice: A school in Lagos buys 6 boxes of chalk at ₦500 per box. What is the total cost? A. ₦1,000 B. ₦2,500 C. ₦3,000 D. ₦3,500. Answer with the correct option and one calculation.

Multiple choice: Which process allows green plants to use sunlight to make food? A. Respiration B. Photosynthesis C. Evaporation D. Condensation. Answer with the correct option and one sentence of explanation.
